newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: PNOC-EC group ends Calauit oil well tests.
newsitem.headline: PNOC-EC group ends Calauit oil well tests.

text.p: A 10-member consortium led by Philippine National Oil Co-Exploration Corp had ended its oil well tests in southwestern Philippines, the Department of Energy said on Friday.
"The operator (has) shut the well while tests data are being evaluated," the department said in a bulletin. PNOC-EC is the oil and gas exploration arm of the state-run PNOC.
The group started testing the Calauit oil field last May 15 and last flowed 5,100 barrels of oil per day (bopd).
The consortium which conducted the tests to access the commercial viability of the field was hoping to flow 10,000 bopd, energy department officials said.
The group has earmarked $5.5 million for the testing. The field is estimated to contain two million to 80 million barrels of oil. -- Manila Newsroom (63 2) 841-8938 Fax 817-6267
